newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares jump on back of foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares jump on back of foreign buying.

text.p: Slovenian shares rose 2.19 percent on Tuesday on the back of buying from foreign investors and traders expect the market to continue rising short-term.
"The mood on the market is rather optimstic and I think we can expect the formation of a positive trend," Alain Al Soufi, a trader at brokers BPH said.
* Drug maker Lek's A issue was the most active share, firming 3.57 percent to 20,300 tolars on volume of 3,269 shares.
* Overall nine shares rose, four fell, while 12 were untraded. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
